capabilities: Log media entries on a month-view calendar
Fetch cover art from TMDB, AniList, IGDB and other sources
Reorder and drag entries between days
Store all entries in one JSON vault file
Back up and recover data from malformed or unreadable files
extras: API keys are stored in plain text in data.json, so the README advises excluding the plugin folder from unencrypted or public sync targets. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Optional Buy Me a Coffee support link; no telemetry, accounts, or ads.
problem: Obsidian has no calendar view for tracking what you read, watch, play, or listen to each day, with cover art per entry.

relations.evidence: Metadata and artwork are provided by TMDB, Open Library, Google Books, AniList, IGDB, RAWG, and Apple.
